def: a Zebulonite or descendant of Zebulun

occurrences.text: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
